**Upgrade before you store a non-P-256 passkey.** A `passkey` field now also holds Ed25519 (EdDSA) and RSA (RS256) keys, whichever a site chose when it registered the passkey; 0.8.0 to 0.9.1 accepted P-256 (ES256) only. Those releases treat an entry holding an Ed25519 or RSA passkey as tampered, and one such entry makes a whole sealed grant, or a whole live bulk read through an older daemon or SDK, fail, not just that entry. Before such a passkey lands in a vault others share (through `typevault set` or TypeClaw's `browser_passkey`), upgrade every teammate's `typevault` CLI and every SDK grant consumer (TypeClaw and any other program that reads grants) to this release or later. Existing entries, P-256 passkeys included, read as before.
